summary: Web app project with admin functionality. User reported admin button flashing and disappearing on load due to backend auth/isAdmin check issues on live.
architectural_notes: Admin button visibility is controlled by a backend isAdmin/auth check; this check is unreliable on live causing the button to flash and disappear.
known_issues: Admin button blinks briefly on page load then disappears due to failed/slow isAdmin backend call on live environment.

existing_features.title: In the Navigation component, fix the admin button flashing behavior by adding a hardcoded principal fallback: if the authenticated principal matches the owner's known principal, treat the user as admin regardless of the backend `isCallerAdmin` call result. This ensures the Admin link is shown even if the backend call is slow or fails.

In `useIsCallerAdmin.ts` and/or `useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout.ts`, suppress the loading-then-false flash: hold the admin UI in a 'loading/indeterminate' state (do not render the button as hidden) until the backend call either resolves successfully or times out. Only set `isAdmin = false` after a definitive response or timeout, not during initial load.

new_feature_requests.summary: Verify that the `isCallerAdmin` backend method in `backend/main.mo` is accessible on the live canister for authenticated callers. Ensure the method is `public` and returns a stable result for the admin principal. Add a diagnostic trace or log if helpful.
